adaptive_selection.rule: Select maximum Shannon entropy using only the anonymous top-tied candidate mask, remaining feature IDs, and predicted categorical values; exact entropy ties use field_order.

baseline_binary_measurement.prompt_template:
Consider both patterns below. Do not choose the one that sounds better. Describe what actually happened.
Pattern A: {display_anchor_a}
Pattern B: {display_anchor_b}
Childhood, before age 13: give one specific event or repeated situation showing which pattern, if either, was more characteristic.
Current adult life: give one specific event or repeated situation in a different setting showing which pattern, if either, is more characteristic now.
Contrast: give one specific situation where your usual pattern did not apply or changed.
If you cannot remember or neither pattern fits, say that directly.

rules.condition: P(childhood) and P(current) and neither supports N
N(childhood) and N(current) and neither supports P
stages conflict or either required unit supports both
only one required life stage supports either anchor
both required units are specific but support neither anchor
required units absent, nonresponsive, incoherent, or instruction-only

baseline_binary_measurement.specificity_rule: A unit states participant behavior or process, context, and event or recurrence. Repetition of the same event is one unit; adjectives alone are not evidence.

birth_quality_and_eligibility.participant_exposure_rule: Record prior HD/astrology exposure descriptively for stratification; exposure alone is not an automatic participant exclusion.
birth_quality_and_eligibility.participant_h1_exposure_divergence_reaso: Participant exposure is descriptive rather than an automatic exclusion because the participant supplies measured narrative, whereas H1 requires an independently clean author of interpretation or construct content.
birth_quality_and_eligibility.source_boundary: No source-document image is collected. The declared recorded time defines the tested true state and does not prove the historical birth moment was error-free.

candidate_normalization.baseline: 1 when any frozen predicate grouped under the observable matches; otherwise 0.
candidate_normalization.channel: 1 exactly when the canonical channel occurs in the candidate defined-channel tuple; otherwise 0.
candidate_normalization.contradiction_mastery_repetition: Candidate value 1 means the 16-48 predicate is present and predicts mastery through practice; participant denial is evidence against it.

channel_measurement.allocation: One process record and one evidence-unit ID may support at most one channel.
channel_measurement.family_score: If m channel fields are scorable, matched_binary_labels/m; omit the family when m=0; maximum family weight is 1.

independent_binary_rules.0: One context-only record demonstrates in two settings that the proposed process is not stable cross-context.
independent_binary_rules.1: One reliable-process record has childhood and current units that both support the channel construct.
independent_binary_rules.mixed: Both qualifying records exist; abstain in scoring.

channel_measurement.omission_rule: Unmentioned channels are abstentions, never inferred absences; unobserved candidates receive neither credit nor penalty.

classifier_confidence.0.50: plausible but minimum evidence or specificity inadequate
classifier_confidence.0.65: minimum evidence exactly met and narrowest defensible label set returned
classifier_confidence.0.80: minimum evidence exceeded with consistent cross-context support
classifier_confidence.0.95: at least three distinct supporting units across required contexts, no substantive counterevidence, and one uniquely supported label

allowed_inputs: per-job field ID, task kind, side lens, body/domain role, complete vocabulary, anchors, minimum-evidence rule, confidence rubric, and evidence units
forbidden_recursive_keys: any hash derived from forbidden values

classifier_transport.candidate_blind_context: A fresh ChatGPT Pro or Codex context containing only the frozen classifier contract and admissible sealed case material.
classifier_transport.selected_model_family_mismatch_rule: A selected or returned different model family produces TECHNICAL_FAIL with no score or rank.
classifier_transport.transport_failure_rule: One identical transport retry; second failure is TECHNICAL_FAIL with no rank.
classifier_transport.unavailable_rule: If a $0 candidate-blind entitled context cannot be executed, the scientific case is BLOCKED.

development_result_labels.MEASUREMENT_INCOMPLETE: no scorable evidence or withdrawal before answer lock

domain_measurement.design_prompt: Describe the recurring pattern in this domain that happens automatically, surprises you afterward, or has repeatedly been noticed by other people even when you do not strongly identify with it. Give one specific example before age 13, one specific current example in a different setting, and one nearby pattern that does not fit.

jupiter.minimum_evidence: Two life stages or contexts and one example where violating the principle produced an obstacle or loss of growth.
jupiter.role: A recurring principle, opportunity pattern, protection, or personal rule associated with sustainable growth.

mars.minimum_evidence: An early manifestation, a current manifestation, and an explicit description of change.
mars.role: A theme that begins immaturely or awkwardly and develops through repeated experience and maturation.

mercury.minimum_evidence: Two life stages or communication contexts supporting each eligible label, plus a subject that matters but is not repeatedly communicated.
mercury.role: Subjects or messages repeatedly expressed in speech, writing, teaching, explanation, advice, or argument.

moon.minimum_evidence: Childhood and current examples supporting each eligible gate label, plus a non-driver contrast.
moon.role: Recurring drive or pressure that gets action moving.

neptune.minimum_evidence: Two life-stage/context examples and explicit uncertainty or opacity; clarity alone cannot satisfy this domain.
neptune.role: Recurring mystery, imagination, spirituality, obscurity, or a domain difficult for the person to see clearly.

pluto.minimum_evidence: Earlier and current manifestations plus an explicit transformation or deepening.
pluto.role: Long-duration transformation, truth-seeking, renewal, or a theme that deepens through major experience.

profile.minimum_evidence: Two life stages, one relational or opportunity example, and one negative profile contrast.
profile.role: Combined learning style, social role, relational/opportunity pattern, and developmental trajectory.

saturn.minimum_evidence: One earlier difficulty, one current mature or continuing form, and a contrast showing where this lesson is not central.
saturn.role: Recurring discipline, accountability, consequence, or demanding lesson that matures into competence.

south_node.minimum_evidence: One childhood environment, one adolescent or early-adult environment, and one later-life contrast.
south_node.role: Earlier-life environment, scenery, or perspective; it must not be coded as a personality trait.

uranus.minimum_evidence: Two contexts or life stages and one convention the participant does follow.
uranus.role: Recurring unconventional originality, mutation, or departure from convention.

venus.minimum_evidence: Early-life and adult examples supporting each eligible label, plus a value contrast.
venus.role: Values, ethics, boundaries, ideals, integrity, or what is worth protecting.

evidence_custody: Personality and Design are separate answer blocks and classifier jobs.
Personality jobs use only self-recognized childhood, current, and contrast units.
Design jobs use only automatic or other-observed childhood, current, and contrast units.
No evidence unit may be reassigned between sides.
NFKC, lowercase, whitespace-collapse, and trim are applied to complete units; normalized cross-side duplicates invalidate both units.
The conscious/less-conscious distinction remains a tested doctrine hypothesis, not an assumed fact.
domain_measurement.personality_prompt: Describe the recurring pattern in this domain that you consciously recognize and identify as your own. Give one specific example before age 13, one specific current example in a different setting, and one nearby pattern that does not fit you.
domain_measurement.ties: Return every tied eligible label; first is primary_archetype and all others are secondary_archetypes; scoring treats the set symmetrically.
